courses.name: RANZCR Trainee SMART Workshop (research and evidence appraisal, one day)
courses.notes: One-day interactive workshop for radiology trainees on critical appraisal of clinical research and evidence-based medicine.

courses.name: Foundations of Leadership in Radiation Oncology (FLiRO)
courses.typicalLength: online session, then 1.5 days in person
courses.notes: Interdisciplinary leadership course for the radiation oncology professions: an online session and modules, then an in-person program in Melbourne.

courses.name: SHINE SA IUD Insertion Training: practical workshop (2.5 hours)
courses.notes: The practical workshop of SHINE SA's three-part IUD insertion training for doctors (online module, workshop with pelvic models, then three supervised clinical sessions). The general IUD training type is held by the womens-gp source.

courses.name: Focussed Cardiac Ultrasound 2-Day Workshop (Cardiac Skills Australia)

formatEvidence.quote: Our accredited 2‑day Focussed Cardiac Ultrasound workshop is designed for medical professionals seeking practical, clinically relevant cardiac ultrasound skills.

courses.notes: Two-day hands-on point-of-care cardiac ultrasound workshop in small groups (junior doctors to consultants, rural GPs); scanning real people.

courses.name: Diastolic Dysfunction & Measurements Made Easy! one-day workshop (Cardiac Skills Australia)

formatEvidence.quote: Our one-day workshop provides a focused, clinically relevant deep dive into left ventricular diastolic function, tailored for point-of-care ultrasound users.

courses.notes: One-day workshop on left ventricular diastolic function for point-of-care ultrasound users.

courses.name: Resuscitation skills for general practice (SWSPHN evening workshop)
courses.notes: Face-to-face CPR refresher for GPs and practice teams using ARC guidelines, presented by Medics for Life.

courses.name: Ace the OSCE: ACEM OSCE preparation course (Westmead, one day)

providers.name: Ace the OSCE (FACEM faculty, Westmead Simulation Centre)

courses.notes: Whole-day coached OSCE practice for ACEM Fellowship OSCE candidates at the Westmead simulation centre (SiLECT), with free online materials beforehand.

courses.name: Advanced GI Endoscopy Workshop (UWA CTEC, Perth)
courses.notes: Hands-on workshop at the UWA Clinical Training & Evaluation Centre, Perth. Suitable for (workshop list): Trainees and Consultants in Gastroenterology and Endoscopy; General Surgeons with Conjoint Committee Certification for endoscopic procedures.

courses.notes: Hands-on workshop at the UWA Clinical Training & Evaluation Centre, Perth. Suitable for (workshop list): Trainees, Fellows & Junior Consultants in ENT Surgery; Limited positions for Observers; Limited assistant Theatre Nurses positions.
